description: Player 2's aggro deck for the full seeded game: the same rule as 01-aggro-a - every card is choice-free at play time and opens no PendingChoice - with a different twenty so the two seats are not mirror images and the recorded log exercises both sides' scripts. #1 Big D-fender and #19 Midrange Menace are the defensive anchors, #89 Corpse Eater grows in hand off both sides' deaths, #64 Gifted Program and #81 Radiant Saintess put the Radiant layer into the log, and #75 Infinite Reserves keeps a long game out of fatigue so a draw at the turn cap is reached by the cap and not by a fatigue race.
